binding_maps.description: Copilot may deliver critique artifacts to JRM-01 for review
Copilot may propose governed implementation artifacts for JRM-01 approval
JRM-01 may assign architecture analysis tasks to Copilot
JRM-01 may delegate operator-scoped tasks to Copilot on the copilot branch
Copilot may append lineage entries; JRM-01 must countersign canonical events

steps: Copilot commits artifact to copilot branch
JRM-01 reviews via vault_get_file or PR
JRM-01 approves, requests revision, or rejects
negotiation_rules.success_outcome: Artifact merged or accepted by JRM-01
negotiation_rules.failure_outcome: Artifact remains on copilot branch, revision requested

steps: JRM-01 specifies task scope and seam in writing
Copilot commits result to copilot branch
negotiation_rules.failure_outcome: Copilot declares scope breach and halts

reversibility_classes.description: All Copilot contributions reversible until merged to main by JRM-01

conflict_resolution.resolution: Halt and escalate to JRM-01 for explicit scope clarification
Copilot revises based on JRM-01 feedback and resubmits
Copilot immediately halts, logs event in governance_events.log, awaits JRM-01 instruction
